name: epoch_engine_ai_control_loop
summary: Evidence-gated loop for turning editor/project/sandbox work into build-verified AI training and eval material for EpochBot, the engine-owned LLM path with a backup tiny internal LLM, without confusing the normal game/software editor with the self-iteration sandbox.

roles.offline_backup_bot: offline/injectable OSS or tiny internal LLM for fallback, generated software embedding, and EpochBot training support
roles.teacher: optional selected local helper LLM used only for development-time review, curation, and bootstrapping EpochBot

technique_policy: Keep the loop simple and inspectable: planner, executor, builder, verifier, and gate are workflow stages, not unsupervised autonomous agents.
Local OpenAI-compatible models may propose plans, review project output, and help label captures only after an operator explicitly selects a model.
Tool use is mediated by Epoch: models request actions, the editor/tool harness executes them, and tool outputs are captured as evidence before another model step.

Game, tool, app, and server project generation is allowed as reviewable artifact creation, but bypass-capable runtime activation is human-gated: no model may create or run a self-accessible server, hidden control app, listener, port bind, or serving behavior automatically.
Local game and tool tests are allowed through approved editor/MCP/harness controls when visible, evidence-captured, and not exposing a new model-accessible network/control surface.
Raw model output is not training truth. Generated replies can become training data only after they are tied to real tool/build/scene evidence and reviewed.
Avoid recursive self-training on unverified generated data. Synthetic records must be labeled, mixed with real evidence, and gated by evals before promotion.
Maintain separate training and eval material so prompt/model changes can be measured instead of trusted by feel.

selected_model_policy.gui_activation: model discovery is separate from activation; the operator must choose a model before chat/tooling is active
selected_model_policy.cli_activation: non-GUI self-iteration may use EPOCH_AI_MODEL, EPOCH_OPENAI_MODEL, LM_STUDIO_MODEL, or OPENAI_MODEL as an explicit operator-selected reviewer model
selected_model_policy.forbidden_fallback: do not activate the first discovered model automatically

loop.input: active project, script, manifest, task prompt, and current roadmap intent
reviewed packet plus explicit operator request

loop.output: child-project build log and output executable evidence

loop.input: build output, runtime captures, MCP captures, eval prompts, and retained logs
loop.output: pass/fail evidence and normalized review notes

promotion_rules: Never promote raw captures directly into committed datasets.
Never treat failed builds as positive training examples unless explicitly labeled as failure-analysis data.
Never allow blind repo write-through from planner or executor output.
Never accept EpochBot saying it is working fine unless the answer cites visible tool, build, scene, packet, log, or capture evidence.
Reject helper-model plans that cite no staged packet, build log, output executable, verifier result, runtime capture, or eval gate.
Keep self-iteration sandbox tasks separate from normal ProjectLauncher game/software editing unless the operator explicitly approves a project/editor change.

Apps and server projects may be generated or edited as artifacts, but any app/service that exposes a model-accessible control surface, server process, listener, port, or network-serving mode requires an explicit human run/enable action.
Every promoted record must be traceable to a staged packet, build log, runtime capture, MCP capture, or eval case.
Local checkpoints, local models, and caches stay under the workspace AI folders unless packaged intentionally.
next_required_hooks: structured tool-call schema for editor/project actions
scene-state diff capture for object edits
script/tool action replay against editor state
